mapper.select: select r.borrow_id, r.book_id, r.user_id, b.book_name, u.user_name, r.borrow_time, r.due_time, r.return_time, case when r.return_time is not null then '1' when r.due_time < now() then '2' else r.status end as status from lib_borrow r left join lib_book b on b.book_id = r.book_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by r.borrow_id desc
select count(*) from lib_borrow where book_id = #{bookId} and user_id = #{userId} and return_time is null
mapper.insert: insert into lib_borrow (book_id, user_id, borrow_time, due_time, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{bookId}, #{userId}, now(), date_add(now(), interval 14 day), '0', #{createBy}, now())
mapper.select: select book_id from lib_borrow where borrow_id = #{borrowId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update lib_borrow set return_time = now(), status = '1', update_by = #{username}, update_time = now() where borrow_id = #{borrowId} and user_id = #{userId} and return_time is null and status in ('0', '2')
